summary: KKR FS Income Trust Select filed an 8-K reporting a routine monthly issuance of 484,782.601 Class I shares at $24.84/share for aggregate consideration of ~$12.042 million, pursuant to its continuous private offering of up to $5.0 billion. The offering relies on Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D, limited to accredited investors. No special-situation event (acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, etc.) is present; this is a standard ongoing capital raise for a non-traded BDC. As of June 30, 2026, net asset value was ~$1.006 billion. The company will continue monthly sales. No premium, break fee, or structural complexity to watch.
